The '''Rost Mountains''' were [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on [[Ragoon VI|Ragoon-6]].

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wren Honoran]] landed [[Gender/Legends|his]] spacecraft there so that his passengers, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|learner]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], could engage in a challenge where they had to track Honoran down in the wilderness.
